name: check-lock
description: Validate composer.json/composer.lock and package.json/package-lock.json coherence and report via reviewdog.

paths.description: Comma-separated list of directories to check for lock files.

name.description: Name reported by reviewdog to identify this check.

reporter.description: Reporter of reviewdog command [github-pr-check,github-check,github-pr-review]. Defaults to the reporter resolved by setup-reviewdog for this run's context (github-pr-check on pull requests, github-check otherwise).

fail-level.description: Exit code for reviewdog if it finds at least the specified level of diagnostic [none,any,info,warning,error].

has-drift.description: true if at least one lock file could not be verified as coherent — either it is out of sync with its manifest, or the check itself could not run (tool missing, validator failed) — false otherwise

drift-files.description: Comma-separated list of lock files that triggered a finding (out of sync, or unverifiable).
